entries.title: Tell HN: Political Detox Week – No politics on HN for one week
entries.author: dang
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Political Detox Week – No politics on HN for one week
entries.excerpt: Like everyone else, HN has been on a political binge lately. As an experiment, we're going to try something new and have a cleanse. Starting today, it's Political Detox Week on HN. For one week, political stories are off-topic. Please flag them. Please also flag political threads on non-political stories. For our part, we'll kill such stories and threads when we see them. Then we'll watch together to see what happens. Why? Political conflicts cause harm here. The values of Ha
entries.guide_zh: HN 试行一周“政治排毒”，暂时将政治新闻与相关讨论列为离题内容。

entries.title: Ask HN: How do I get freelance developer jobs?
entries.author: jamesmp98
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do I get freelance developer jobs?
entries.excerpt: Sure there are sites like Upwork or Freelancer, but they limit the amount of jobs that you can bid for. I'm not sure if I could successfully get jobs there, so I don't want to waste any bids. People jump on any good projects like crazy. Aside from that, I've been told to scout out local business, but for the moment lets just say that one's a no. How can I get freelancing jobs as a developer?
entries.guide_zh: 接单平台限制竞标次数，新自由开发者怎样更有效地获得工作？
